text:
Carla M.: heads up — onboarding failure from AcmeCorp. Their Datadog pipeline is rejecting our audit JSONL with 'invalid signature' after a KMS key rotation yesterday. Also some events arriving to S3 show truncated payloads (last line partial json).
Ben R.: rolling — which KMS key rotated? customer using envelope encryption via KMS-ENCRYPTION-KEY-123? Any sigs in headers?
Alice K.: seen similar when we rotated envelope key without rotating signing key in our webhook packager. Datadog expects X-Signature header HMAC-SHA256 over body using legacy signing secret. Are we still sending that?
Carla M.: payloads from webhook exporter include header X-Audit-Sig: sha256=abc123... security-bot shows rotation at 2098700000 (rotation job).
security-bot: KMS key rotation completed for env 'prod-us' at 2098700000. key id: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/r-infer-prod-2026-rot
Josh L.: S3 multipart note — we hit a bug where final CompleteMultipartUpload didn't include the last part checksum if part size < 5MB; leads to truncated object. PR #4721 fixed but not rolled. Could be that.
Ben R.: action: verify package that signs webhook uses current signing secret; check packager logs for 'signing key mismatch'.
Alice K.: quick check — sample payload that failed: ```{
  "tenant_id": "acme-123",
  "event_type":"model.deploy",
  "actor":{"id":"svc-deploy","role":"system"},
  "meta":{"request_id":"r-987"}
}``` Datadog ingest error: invalid_json_line at line 5 (end of file).
Carla M.: also noticed RBAC masking removed tenant_id from some audit events after policy change this morning. Could be race between RBAC mask roll and packager. We must avoid masking tenant identifiers for audit export.
Josh L.: I'll roll the multipart fix to prod canary in 10m. Ben — can you revert RBAC mask for export route until we have a safer rule?
Ben R.: yep will revert mask for route audit/export for accounts flagged. I'll follow up with a postmortem template and add mitigation steps.
Carla M.: thanks. Owners: Josh (S3/multipart deploy), Ben (RBAC revert + signing secret check), Alice (Datadog ingest with sample). I'll coordinate with support to notify AcmeCorp. cc @oncall-ops.
oncall-ops: ACK. Creating incident INC-209876 on pager duty with severity 3.
